spec_used: Cover of the 7-slide carousel 2026-w43-1b (Mon 19 Oct), from the packet (alt text 1): 'Fletore e hapur dhe telefon me kapak të kuq në një tavolinë pranë dritares, me kullën e sahatit. Teksti: 5 numra që duhet t'i dish çdo muaj.' Optional: small gold counter '1/7', crimson round arrow button bottom right. House cover structure from the locked style sheet runs/SS-LIB-STYLE/shots/SHEET-STYLE.spec.yaml (kicker 'PËR PRONARËT E BIZNESEVE', headline, subline, counter, real logo bottom left). Style: style-bible.md (Tirana at night, warm tungsten light, crimson #B31217 highlight rectangles, red-cased phone, gold only for the counter). Brand: brand-kit.md (real logo files only, no invented numbers, no other brands' logos, no em dashes).

checks.evidence: The 1-second read is there (full.jpg, thumb_200.jpg): a heavy ivory headline '5 numra që duhet t'i dish çdo muaj' with '5 numra' in a crimson box, over an open blank notebook with a pen and a red-cased phone on a table by a night window with the clock tower. With the sound off it reads as 'five numbers you must know every month', with the notebook ready for them.

It matches the cover line and scene in alt text 1. The open notebook (region_SL01_notebook_2x.jpg) and the red-cased phone (region_SL01_phone_2x.jpg) are on a wooden table beside the window, and the clock tower is outside (tile_r1c3.jpg). The headline string is the planned hook (plans/2026-W43.json).

Nothing contradicts the brand kit. The only figure is the '5' that counts the list, so there is no invented statistic. No number appears on paper or on a screen: the notebook pages are blank lined (region_SL01_notebook_2x.jpg) and the phone lies face down. The image shows no price, result, client or claim, and no em dash.
No people, hands or limbs anywhere in the frame (all 9 tiles).
No hands. The scene is a still life.
No faces.

Everything rests on the table and nothing floats. The notebook lies open and flat, its pages curving at the spine. The pen lies across the right page and casts a soft shadow on it (region_SL01_notebook_2x.jpg). The phone lies flat with a contact shadow along its lower edge (region_SL01_phone_2x.jpg, tile_r3c3.jpg).

The structures are correct. Phone (region_SL01_phone_2x.jpg): back facing up, a triple camera module in the top-left corner, side buttons on the long edge, and speaker grille, USB-C port and grille on the bottom short edge, which is opposite the cameras. Pen: gold tip, black barrel, gold centre band, clip on the cap end. Notebook: two page blocks, a spine and a red ribbon marker. Desk lamp: dome shade, stem and weighted base, cut by the left edge. The window has straight vertical frames. The curved lit rim behind the table at left (region_SL01_backrest_lamp_2x.jpg) is out of focus and reads as the back of a curved wooden chair. It is not a broken object, and it is identical in v1.

Read letter by letter at 2x. Headline line 1 (region_SL01_headline_l1_2x.jpg): '5' / n-u-m-r-a (inside the crimson box) / q-ë / d-u-h-e-t. Line 2 (region_SL01_headline_l2_2x.jpg): t-'-i / d-i-s-h / ç-d-o / m-u-a-j. Together they give exactly '5 numra që duhet t'i dish çdo muaj': the ë has two dots, the ç has its cedilla, the apostrophe is straight as in the spec, there is no final punctuation, and nothing is missing or extra. Kicker (region_SL01_kicker_2x.jpg): P-Ë-R / P-R-O-N-A-R-Ë-T / E / B-I-Z-N-E-S-E-V-E, the locked house label from SHEET-STYLE, with two dots on both Ë. Subline (region_SL01_subline_2x.jpg): P-a / t-o-',' / r-r-i-t-j-a / b-ë-h-e-t / m-e / h-a-m-e-n-d-j-e-'.', with two dots on the ë. Counter (region_SL01_counter_3x.jpg): '1/7'. The logo wordmark is the real file (see V24).

All text sits on the dark wall and the dark window frame and glass in the upper left. No object passes in front of a letter and no letter falls on a prop. The tower stays right of the headline, with about 28 px between the 't' of 'duhet' (x~812) and the tower (x~840) (tile_r1c2.jpg, tile_r1c3.jpg). The counter and the arrow are clear of the window frame and the props.

There is no unwanted text: no signs or labels in the street through the window, a plain unmarked phone back, a pen with no brand, and blank notebook pages. The only mark on the pages is a faint printed date dash at the top right of the right page, with no characters (region_SL01_notebook_2x.jpg). The drawn fake logo of v1 is gone and no ghost letters remain (V24).

Every story prop is present, visible and well sized: the open notebook (ruled pages, left blank on purpose because the numbers are filled in on slide 7 and the brand forbids invented numbers on paper), the red-cased phone, the table by the window and the clock tower. Nothing that should have content is empty: the phone is face down, so it has no screen to fill.

The thread prop matches the style bible: a smartphone in a deep red case (lit mean #711C0B under the tungsten light, a deep red that reads as the #BE0F18 case), with a leather-like texture and a red camera surround (region_SL01_phone_2x.jpg).
Nothing appears without a reason. The lamp, pen and chairs belong to a desk by a window, and there is no second phone or other stray object.
No characters.
The phone shows the thread's opening state, 'silent': it lies face down with no light or notifications. The cover is the first slide, so there is no previous shot.

The setting matches 'Tirana after dark': through the right-hand window there is a square-shafted clock tower with lit clock faces, an arched gallery and a pyramid roof, a domed building behind it, wet paving with reflections and warm street lamps (tile_r1c3.jpg, tile_r2c3.jpg, region_SL01_clocktower_3x.jpg). The clock hands are softened by the depth of field, as expected for a background plane.

1080x1350 (4:5). The text and graphics stay inside the margins. Kicker top y=63; headline x 106 to ~812. The logo sits at x100 to 391, y1211 to 1265: left margin 100 px and bottom margin 85 px (6.3%). The arrow button at x932 to 991, y1211 to 1271 is centred at y~1241, on the logo's centre line (y~1238), so the bottom row is balanced. The counter glyph top is at y=52, which is 2 px into the style sheet's outer-4% band (54 px). That is a measurement only, invisible, on the counter rather than key content, and identical in v1. Instagram does not crop the top of a 4:5 feed post. The 3:4 profile-grid crop trims about 34 px per side, and all text, the counter, the logo and the arrow stay inside it. The logo top runs 17 px above the style bible's bottom-9% band, which sits on calm dark wood and is not a defect.

At 200 px wide (thumb_200.jpg) the headline '5 numra që duhet t'i dish çdo muaj' is still readable, the crimson box stands out, and the notebook, red phone and clock tower are recognisable. The kicker is too small to read at that size, as expected for a kicker, and it is not part of the hook. The subline can still be read. The logo is visible as the red mark and the white wordmark.
A still-life cover with no people. The background is not frozen or posed: the street outside has lit lamps, bokeh and wet reflections (tile_r2c3.jpg).

It matches the style bible: a cinematic night interior in warm tungsten light from the desk lamp, a near-black wall, Tirana at night through the window with the clock tower, and fine grain. Type is ivory (#F9F7F2 measured vs #F8F6EF), heavy and left-aligned in the calm dark area. Highlight: solid crimson rectangle behind '5 numra' (#AD1319 measured vs #B31217). The arrow button is crimson (#A71418). Gold appears only in the small counter (#CF9942 measured, AA edges) and in the real logo file's gold square, which the style bible allows. The props' brass and gold trim are scene materials, not graphic colour. The warm-lit facades outside sit inside the tungsten grade.

It looks photoreal: open wood grain with specular streaks, a pebbled leather texture on the phone case, paper texture and ruling on the pages, lamp glare and bokeh. There is no plastic or CG sheen (tiles r2c1, r3c2, r3c3; region_SL01_phone_2x.jpg).

The fix left no artefacts. The fix touched only x99 to 390, y1210 to 1265: pixels changed by more than 30 levels against v1 lie only there, and 0 lie outside the logo zone (diffmap_orig_vs_fixed.jpg). The rest of the frame differs from v1 only by JPEG re-encode noise. That box is almost entirely covered by the pasted logo, because the real logo lands on v1's drawn footprint (v1 mark x~102 to 152, y~1211 to 1264). In the boosted and gamma crops at 3x (region_logo_bg_masked_boost_3x.jpg, region_logozone_fixed_gamma_3x.jpg) the wood grain runs through the letter gaps, the S-channel of the mark and the margins with no blur patch, rectangle seam or colour blotch. Row and column gradients just outside the box (0.4 to 2.1 levels) match the untouched surroundings, and there is no edge jump. Background luminance 1 to 12 px from the logo is flat (14.5, 16.1, 14.7, 14.2 ... 13.9), so there is no dark or light halo. The ring 30 px around the box measures the same in v1 and v2 (mean 9.2, texture 0.59 vs 0.58). Elsewhere the 9 tiles show no smears, duplicated objects, warped straight lines or half-rendered areas.

The logo is the real file. The pasted logo (region_logo_fixed_4x.jpg, region_logozone_orig_vs_fixed_2x.jpg) is the real straightscale-logo-light.png (ref_logo_light_on_dark.jpg): a red rounded square with the S-shaped channel, a gold square in the top-right notch, and the white 'StraightScale' wordmark. Fitting the real file at 291x54 at (100,1211) gives a mean absolute difference of 4.35 levels over its 4298 opaque pixels. Red measures 182/13/26 vs 194/8/23 and gold 221/171/38 vs 225/171/26. The aspect is 5.389 vs the file's 5.380, so it is undistorted. It is crisp, with a max edge gradient of 229 vs 239 for the file on black. No remnant of v1's drawn logo survives: no ghost of the plain 'S' block or of the drawn wordmark, and v1's drawn gold square (which ran to x~159) is gone, with the pixels at x153 to 161, y1205 to 1223 at most R58 G33 (dark wood) and nothing red or gold above the mark (region_logozone_boosted_orig_top_fixed_bottom.jpg). No other brand's logo appears: the phone back, pen and lamp are unbranded.
No before and after, no 'your [condition]' and no shaming. 'Pa to, rritja bëhet me hamendje' ('without them, growth is guesswork') teaches and does not blame the reader.
No AI person and no AI voice, so STANDARDS section 7 does not require the AI label for this slide. Nothing on the image claims to be a real photo of a client or a result.

defects_summary.rule: Hero asset: PASS only with zero defects of any severity. Zero found, so PASS.

notes: Copy-gate notes, not visual defects and not counted in the status. All are pre-existing (identical in v1).
(1) Alt text 1 leaves out the on-image kicker 'PËR PRONARËT E BIZNESEVE' and the subline 'Pa to, rritja bëhet me hamendje.'

(2) For the pending native Albanian read (qa.md): the subline's 'Pa to' refers to 'numra', which is masculine in the caption ('Pa këta numra'). The masculine form after a preposition may be 'Pa ta'. Please confirm.
(3) The headline lines are 16 and 17 characters, against STANDARDS 6's 'about 12' for cover lines. It is 8 words in 2 lines (within 4 to 10) and passes the 200 px test.
